messages:
Mia (Sales): Hospica POC ask: process+store only in UK (europe-west2) + Canada (northamerica-northeast1). BYOK required. They need subprocessor list, confirmation of no US egress, and a 6-week POC ballpark. @Arjun @Nina @Cole
Arjun (Presales): Feasible via Dedicated-regional or Private. Hosted public API cannot guarantee zero control-plane signaling to US unless we enable regional control-plane or Private. Need to confirm whether control-plane must be in-region.
Nina (Infra): Data-plane pinning OK. Control-plane default is centralized (US) -> regional control-plane add-on possible (one-off ~$3k/region). BYOK supported via partner HSM in-region; customer key import required. Caveats: OCSP/CRL, time-sync (NTP), and package repo pulls may reach external endpoints unless we mirror/run proxy. That mitigation adds ~3-7 days.
Cole (Legal): I'll prepare subprocessor attestation and DPA addendum. If Hospica insists on absolute no-third-country transfer we require signed risk acceptance for cert/OCSP/time-sync or we implement the proxy and mirror repos.
Mia (Sales): Ballpark pricing for 6-week POC?
Arjun (Presales): Rough: dedicated regional slices + ops ~ $9k/month. Regional control-plane add-on ~$3k per region one-off. Private/VPC option adds one-time integration (~$8-12k) + infra licensing (~$5-6k/mo). Final quote after sizing.
Nina (Infra): Config snippet to forward:
```yaml
mode: dedicated-regional
regions:
  - europe-west2
  - northamerica-northeast1
control_plane: regional-addon
byok: true
egress_policy: deny-third-country
telemetry: regional-only
```
Also: recommend customer sign a cert/OCSP caveat or request local CA proxy.
Cole (Legal): Will include the caveat language in the attestation.
Mia (Sales): Thanks team  I'll send this to Hospica and ask them to pick proxy vs signed caveat. infra-bot: created INFRA-9999 for Hospica subproc export and assigned to Nina.
